يهروا (form I)
# يَهِرُّوا (yahirrū) /ja.hir.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# يُهَرُّوا (yuharrū) /ju.har.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
